summary: Re-test post-fixes (iter 3 -> iter 4). Both blocking issues from iter 3 are resolved: (1) admin email moved to admin@local.dev — POST /api/auth/login returns 200 with httpOnly cookies; (2) Sonner Toaster moved to bottom-right — no overlap with the top-right user-menu-button. Re-ran full pytest suite (29/29 PASS — the previously xfail-ed admin login is now a normal PASS) and re-verified the frontend flows that were blocked in iter 3.

critical_code_review_comments: Both reported issues from iteration 3 are fixed correctly and minimally: ADMIN_EMAIL in backend/.env changed to admin@local.dev (and seed_admin re-inserted the admin in Mongo with bcrypt hash $2b$) and <Toaster position='bottom-right'/> added in App.js.

Optional follow-up (not blocking): consider replacing EmailStr in LoginRequest/RegisterRequest with a custom validator OR documenting that .test/.localhost/.invalid TLDs are intentionally rejected — anyone re-introducing those reserved TLDs in .env will reproduce the iter-3 bug.

Backend continues to use httpOnly + Secure + SameSite=None cookies for the HTTPS preview; bcrypt is correctly applied; brute-force lockout (429) after 5 fails still works.
